name: DeleteServiceNowAttachmentById
label: Delete ServiceNow Attachment
description: Deletes an attachment from ServiceNow using only Credential ID (BasicAuth token or OAuth2 token).

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential ID / Token
fields.description: For BasicAuth → provide Base64(username:password). For OAuth2 → provide Bearer token.

fields.name: AttachmentId
fields.label: Attachment ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the attachment to delete.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API.
